name: 13778 · Greene, NY
findings: ZIP 13778 (Greene) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13778 (Greene) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
